scope: Timer helpers, initialization, and timer-to-radio sweep callback analysis. New portable TIMER C/h implementation only; no existing sources or manifests changed.

0e069ee8.name: timer_initialize
semantics: if config==0: store8(state+8,1); return 0bad0000, context unchanged
otherwise store32(state+4,read32(config+8)); call E069E04(instance,config); state+8=(result==0bad0000); return result

0e069e04.name: timer_configure
semantics: freq=read32(config); quotient=sourceHz/freq, remainder=sourceHz-freq*quotient; reject remainder!=0 OR freq>sourceHz OR (quotient&(quotient-1))!=0 OR quotient>512 with 0bad0004
accept: read config bytes 5 and4; mode +504=(old&~3)|(config[4]&3); bitmode +508=(old&~3)|(config[5]&3); prescaler +510=ctz(quotient)
clear all eight compare events +140..15c in ascending order, each with write0 followed by readback
0e069e04.zero_frequency: ARM UDIV result0 unless trap enabled; then remainder nonzero returns invalid; host model must not divide C by0

0e069f84.name: microseconds_to_ticks
semantics: multiplier selected from same base groups; read prescaler p at base+510
return LSR(lo,p)|LSL(hi,32-p)|LSR(hi,p-32), ARM register shifts use low8 shift and yield0 for shifts>=32. For p in0..63 this is low32(product>>p). Outside range do not replace by unchecked C shift.

0e069ff0.name: milliseconds_to_ticks
semantics: Same multiply/shift algorithm as E069F84; factor1000 larger. Not microseconds.

0e06a064.name: timer_compare_configure
semantics: No explicit channel bounds in firmware; host bounds must be reported as model-domain restriction

0e069d98.name: timer_irq_common
semantics: snapshot pending events by scanning eight +140..15c; clear and read back every nonzero event even if interrupt masked, record bit16+i
for each ascending channel where pending&enabled bit set: reload callback32(state); if nonzero reload context32(state+4); indirectcall(callback,event_offset=140+4*i,context)
Event offset is uint16; 8 channels means140..15c. enabled snapshot is not reloaded after callbacks; callback/context are.

0e05cd04.name: radio_sweep_timer_callback
semantics: type=descriptor[0]; if3 set71e0=1; call E05CBB8(mode=u8d1,power=s8d4,channel=u8[71e1]); reload start=d5,end=d6,step=d7
if type4 set71e0=1; call E05CC4C(mode=u8d1,channel=u8[71e1],pattern=u8d4); reload start=d4,end=d5,step=d6
for type3/4 after target returns: next=uint8(u8[71e1]+step); [71e1]=(next<=end?next:start); [71e0]=0
other types tailcall E05D634(format E06FC88, type); no subsequent writes

0e05d1ac.name: radio_test_init
semantics: call E069EE8(E06FD14,config,E05CD05); non-success calls logging E05D634 but continues
call E06A658(&230071df); success0bad0000 logs channel and returns0; other result logs failure and returnsFFFFFFF2

limitations: Only static analysis; no original Thumb equivalence corpus added by this subtask
Ghidra function body length for E05CD04 is8 due branch body sharing; full raw branch instructions CD0C..CD6A verified in prior full listing
Hardware MMIO readbacks/interrupt masks must be modeled explicitly; write to SET or CLR register cannot be treated as updating another register unless hardware model declares it
